meta.title: AvlMonitor — Real-time mobile georeferencing
meta.description: Desktop Waze + SQL Server client: create a company, get a license, choose a package (product / docs / support) and contact us on WhatsApp.

hero.eyebrow: Desktop .NET (WPF) app: users with permissions, CRUD, address lookup in SQL Server (SPs/triggers) via geocoding, and real-time mobile georeferencing on a Waze-style map — with MVVM and dependency injection (DI).
hero.title: Georeference mobiles on the Waze map, from your organization’s network infrastructure and without going out to the internet
hero.lead: AvlMonitor is a digital product: create your company in the P2L panel, receive a license key, choose a package, and contact us on WhatsApp. Then activate the client on your PC with a .env file.

product.title: Georeference and track mobiles where you already work: from your SQL Server database
product.lead: Not a browser map SaaS: a Windows client you connect to your SQL Server, with embedded Waze. Purchase and licensing live in the P2L web panel; day-to-day operations run on your desktop.
product.c1_title: The map your team already knows
product.c1_text: Live Waze traffic, roads, and incidents inside the app. Less training, more focus on the operation.
product.c2_text: Search, save, and center points that live in your database. Geocoding and reverse geocoding ready for the day’s dispatch.
product.c3_text: Follow mobile positions on the map in real time. One place to see where each point is.

stack.title: What the product includes
stack.lead: Three commercial packages. For now purchase closes via WhatsApp. The install guide is free; the license key is generated when you create your company in the panel.

stack.i2: License key P2L_COMPANY_KEY (shown once at signup)
stack.i3: Company ID P2L_COMPANY_ID (always visible in the panel)

local.title: How local license activation works
local.lead: When you create the company, the panel generates a license key. Together with the company ID and P2L backend, that key activates AvlMonitor on your PC through a .env file.
local.b1_title: Key only when you create the company
local.b1_text: The panel shows P2L_COMPANY_KEY once: copy it and store it safely. P2L_COMPANY_ID stays visible in your account.
local.b2_text: Contact us, create the company, receive the ZIP for your package, and configure .env with ID, key, and P2L_BACKEND_BASE.
local.b3_text: When you launch AvlMonitor, the app validates the license with the P2L backend. With the correct ID and key, the software is active on your machine.

install.title: Get started (the full product)
install.lead: Same flow as the P2L Desktop panel. Choose a package, contact us on WhatsApp, and activate locally.
install.s1_text: Sign in to the panel with Google and register your company. A license key is generated (shown once) plus P2L_COMPANY_ID.
install.s2_text: Product, Product+Docs, or Product+Docs+Support. Contact us on WhatsApp +57 318 098 4087.
install.s3_text: According to the agreed package you get AvlMonitor.zip (and docs/support if applicable). Extract it on Windows.
install.s4_text: Put P2L_COMPANY_ID, P2L_COMPANY_KEY, and P2L_BACKEND_BASE in the .env next to the WPF app and launch AvlMonitor.
